sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/345 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: search/place PlaceId 345, search/grid facilities 831 'Sites 1-60', 413 'Sites 61-210', 412 'Sites 211-237 and B1-B17' for 2027-06-15 and 2027-01-12, search/details for all web-listed units on 2027-06-15, plus one site of each type on 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12 and 2027-06-19, read 2026-10-30)

values.note: Electric sites $39 a night, full hookups $52, the same on a Saturday (June 2027). Off-peak (November 2026, January 2027) both are $35. The 17 non-electric sites B01-B17 ($29, $25 off-peak) are mapped with tent icons a few metres apart and list no pad or rig length, so they don't set the RV base. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all Cowan Lake campsites, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Electric 39.00, Campsite Full Hookup 52.00, Campsite Non-Electric 29.00 with 'Space for Tents: Y' and no length; grid MapInfo UnitImage 'Ohio/Units/tent' for B01-B17), sites 01, 25, B01 on Sat 2027-06-19 (39.00 / 52.00 / 29.00), 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12 (35.00 / 35.00 / 25.00), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: ReserveOhio search/details (Electricity Hookup '50,30,20' on the electric and full-hookup sites; Water Hookup 'Yes' on 36 and Sewer Hookup 'Yes' on 46 full-hookup sites) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/cowan-lake-state-park-campground ('50, 30 or 20-amp service on Electric sites'; 'Full Hook-up sites'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 228 web-bookable RV sites (182 electric, 46 full hookup), back-in, rated 32-59 ft (most 35-49), some with a noted slope; plus 17 non-electric tent sites (B01-B17). ODNR counts 254 campsites. Pets permitted on all sites.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/grid (59 + 143 + 43 units, all AllowWebBooking) + search/details (PullInTypeName 'Back In', Maximum Camping Unit Length 32-59, Pad Slope) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/cowan-lake-state-park-campground ('Cowan Lake Campground offers ... 254 campsites'; 'Pets are permitted on all campsites'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Two shower houses; seasonal commissary (supplies, bait, snacks, bike and kayak rentals); private camp beach, nature center in the campground. Off-peak (Nov. 1 - Apr. 1) only Shower House 1 is open; water from spigots at the check-in station and Shower House 1.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/cowan-lake-state-park-campground ('2 Shower Houses, flush toilets and laundry facilities'; 'Dump Station'; 'We offer a variety of essentials at our Commissary'; 'A private camp beach'; 'Off-Peak Season: From November 1 to April 1, Shower House 1 available with restrooms ... Water spigots available at Check-In Station and Shower House 1'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Off-peak November 1 to April 1: 101 electric, 46 full-hookup (sewer, no water) and 17 non-electric sites reservable; check-in station open weekends.

season.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/cowan-lake-state-park-campground ('Off-Peak Season: From November 1 to April 1 ... Limited reservable sites: 101 Electric sites, 46 Full hook up sites with sewer, no water and 17 non-electric. Dump Station open. ... Check In Station open on weekends.') + ReserveOhio search/grid 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-30

values.note: Reservations up to six months ahead online or at (866) 644-6727. Every listed site is web-bookable with a 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/cowan-lake-state-park-campground ('Reservations may be made up to six months in advance online or by calling (866) 644-6727.') + ReserveOhio search/details (AllowWebBooking true, MaxStay 14), read 2026-10-30

note: Dam rehabilitation 2026-2028: the lake is drawn down 13.5 ft from November 1, 2026, construction early 2027 to spring 2028, water levels targeted to return summer 2028; fishing and kayaking at your own risk until the ramps can't be reached (ODNR, read 2026-10-30). --Claude
summary: Fees base corrected 29 -> 39: the $29 non-electric sites B01-B17 are tent sites (tent icons, no length), so the RV base is the $39 electric site, +$13 full hookup; off-peak $35. Added 50-amp electric with water/sewer at FH sites, 228 back-in RV sites to 59 ft, showers/flush toilets/water/dump/laundry/commissary, year-round with the off-peak site list, ReserveOhio deep link, 6-month window, 14-night max. Note added for the 2026-2028 dam drawdown. Pin 231 m from the RV sites' centroid (fine). Not stated: walk-ups, weekend minimum (left inherited).
flags: Phone missing: the ODNR campground page gives (937) 383-3751; the park office is (937) 382-1096.

Lake drawdown 2026-2028: ODNR 'Cowan Lake dam rehabilitation begins with an early drawdown starting November 1. Water levels will be lowered 13.5 feet ... construction in early 2027 through spring 2028. Target to have water levels restored is Summer 2028.' The campground stays open; recorded in the note, not as a status.
